title: A Humanoid Robot Has Moved 100,000 Totes
description: Agility Robotics says its Digit humanoid has moved more than 100,000 totes at a GXO warehouse in Georgia, and GXO plans more sites from early 2027. GXO's CEO said in August that humanoids have not yet paid back.

beats.text: Humanoids in warehouses: do they pay?
beats.vo: Humanoid robots are in warehouses now. But are they paying off?

beats.text: Digit's tally at one GXO warehouse
beats.vo: Agility's Digit has moved over one hundred thousand totes at a G X O site in Georgia, and more sites start in early twenty twenty seven. But G X O's chief executive said in August that humanoids have not paid back yet.
Follow for a daily dose of engineering.

caption:
100,000+ totes moved by one humanoid. 🤖
Agility's Digit works at a GXO warehouse and the rollout expands from early 2027. The catch: GXO's CEO said in August it hasn't achieved ROI on humanoids yet.
Hype and payback — both are true.
